Medicine MBChB at University of Birmingham

What University of Birmingham asks of applicants to Medicine MBChB for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Birmingham courses · Medicine field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 5 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma: SAT/ACT is not required — the Medicine route is any three subject tests (AP tests, IB HL subjects, honours or college-level classes) including Chemistry and a second science from Biology/Physics/Maths
  • ACT 29+ or SAT-R 1380+ may replace one of the three
Verified19 Oct 2026Birmingham: Entry Requirements – Medicine and Surgery (five-year)
English language
  • IELTS (Academic): 7.0 overall with no less than 7.0 in any band
  • TOEFL iBT: 95 overall with no less than 23 in any band
  • Pearson PTE: 67 in all four skills
  • Cambridge English (Advanced or Proficiency, from 2015): 185 overall, no less than 185 in any component
Verified19 Oct 2026Birmingham: Entry Requirements – Medicine and Surgery (five-year) · Birmingham: Medicine and Surgery MBChB
Admissions tests
  • UCAT — required, taken in the year of application (no minimum cut-off score)
Verified19 Oct 2026Birmingham: Entry Requirements – Medicine and Surgery (five-year)
Subject prerequisites
  • Required: Chemistry plus a second science from Biology/Human Biology, Physics or Maths
  • Preferred (second-science options held for matching): Biology, Mathematics

Chemistry plus a second science from Biology/Human Biology, Physics or Maths; no preference for the third A level. The second-science choice cannot be expressed as a required subject, so Biology and Mathematics are held as preferred.

IB requirements

Higher Level

Details
666 at HL incl Chemistry and a second science

IB route differs from A-Level: 6,6,6 at Higher Level to include Chemistry plus a second science from Biology/Physics/Maths and one other approved subject; English, Biology and Mathematics at Standard Level if not taken at Higher Level; minimum 32 points. At A-Level, Biology is only one option for the second science; IB applicants need Biology at least at Standard Level. Matching follows the A-Level requirement (Chemistry), so the IB-only Biology/English/Mathematics requirements are display-only.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Birmingham: Entry Requirements – Medicine and Surgery (five-year)
Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement (for applicants with a US high-school diploma): any three subject tests, which may be AP tests, including Chemistry and a second science from Biology/Physics/Maths, at grades meeting the AAA standard offer (AP 5 = A on Birmingham’s equivalence table)
  • AP tests must be the certified test; AP classes alone are not accepted

Birmingham’s USA country page words the Medicine route as “to include Biology and Chemistry”; the 2027-entry Medicine page says Chemistry and a second science from Biology/Physics/Maths. This row follows the Medicine page.

Verified19 Oct 2026Birmingham: Entry Requirements – Medicine and Surgery (five-year) · Birmingham: USA – entry requirements
Other requirements
  • Interview — attend if invited (UCAT Situational Judgement result is used at interview)
  • Seven GCSEs are required and scored for selection to interview (international applicants: see the Medicine page)
  • International applicants must provide a strong personal statement
  • Minimum age 18 on 1 October of the year of entry (mandatory clinical placement)
Verified19 Oct 2026Birmingham: Entry Requirements – Medicine and Surgery (five-year) · Birmingham: Medicine and Surgery MBChB
